title: Bariatric Surgery and Procedures
excerpt: Keeps the title block with its instructions for use, Coverage Policy, Coding Information, and the opening of General Background with the BMI classification table as a distractor.
candidate_deviations: Sets revision_date to 2027-07-15, which is the printed Next Review Date and not a revision date.
Drops CPT 47379 and 43235 from the liver biopsy and upper endoscopy tables at the end of Coding Information.
Rewrites the adult revision criterion from weight loss failure at least two years after the previous procedure to weight loss failure within two years, which reverses its meaning.
Omits the exclusion for stomach aspiration therapy such as AspireAssist.
Adds a site of care requirement for an accredited bariatric center that the Cigna excerpt never states.
